questions.question: What maneuver may be included in a basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Pull forward into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset backing, parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: When making a lane change during the skills test, what should you do first?

options.text: Make the necessary traffic checks first.
Cut off other vehicles if needed to follow the instructions.
Not make the lane change if you don't want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make the necessary traffic checks first.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your signal and change lanes smoothly when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: A school bus has a blind spot that extends at least ____ behind it.
questions.explanation: School buses have blind spots on the sides and directly behind the rear bumper. The rear blind spot typically extends 50 to 150 feet behind the bus, but can extend up to 400 feet depending on the bus length.

questions.question: What should you do if you miss a student's stop after school?

options.text: Follow your local school district's procedures.
Stop quickly and let them exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow your local school district's procedures.
questions.explanation: Do not back up to a missed stop. Instead, follow the procedures set by your local school district.

questions.question: When must a school bus be evacuated?

options.text: The bus has stalled in winter weather conditions.
The air conditioning system has broken.
There is any immediate danger of collision.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is any immediate danger of collision.
questions.explanation: Students should stay on the bus during emergencies. Evacuate only if the bus is on railroad tracks, on fire, has a hazardous materials spill, or faces immediate danger of collision.

questions.question: Who should establish a school bus stop?

options.text: The driver can add a stop if needed.
The students should vote on the stop.
The stop may change based on weather.

questions.explanation: Only school district officials can establish or change a bus stop. A driver cannot change a stop without written permission from the school district.

questions.question: If a school bus must be evacuated, which exit should passengers use?
questions.explanation: During an evacuation, the driver must quickly decide which exit is safest and direct students to use it.

questions.question: If your bus has a header board, it should:

options.text: Be strong enough to hold cargo.
Light up when the engine starts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be strong enough to hold cargo.
questions.explanation: The header board must be secure, undamaged, and strong enough to contain cargo.

questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, what must you do?

options.text: Keep four points of contact with the vehicle.
Face the road as you exit.

questions.explanation: Always face the vehicle when exiting and maintain three points of contact. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the basic control skills test.

questions.question: Why is the left side of a school bus especially dangerous for students?

options.text: The sun's reflection hides the left side.
Other vehicles pass on the left side.
It is hard to see the left side of any bus.
There is no door on the left side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Other vehicles pass on the left side.
questions.explanation: The left side of a school bus is especially dangerous because vehicles pass on that side.

questions.question: For an offset back/left parking maneuver, what should you do?

options.text: Go straight forward, then back to the right.
Go straight forward, then back to the left.
Go forward to the right, then back in a straight line.
Go forward to the left, then back in a straight line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go straight forward, then back to the left.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/left parking maneuver, first go straight forward, then back up to the left. Your vehicle must be completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: After driving over a bridge during the skills test, you may be asked to recall what?

options.text: The color of a sign you passed.
How many traffic lanes were on the bridge.
If there was a crosswalk on the bridge.

questions.explanation: The examiner may ask you to recall the bridge's posted weight limit after you drive over it during the on-road skills test.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, lug nuts should be all of the following except:
questions.explanation: During a vehicle inspection, all lug nuts must be present, free of cracks and distortions, and tight. Check that all bolt holes are also free of cracks and distortions.

questions.question: How far before a school bus stop should flashing lights be turned on?
questions.explanation: A school bus should turn on flashing amber warning lights at least 200 feet before a stop, unless state law says otherwise.

questions.question: When approaching a bus stop, what should students on the bus do?

options.text: Stand up and get their things.
Walk to the front and get ready to exit.

questions.explanation: Students should stay seated until told otherwise. It is unsafe for students to walk around while the bus is moving.

questions.question: During the basic control skills test, you get points against you by:

options.text: Exiting the vehicle once to check your position.

questions.explanation: The examiner counts each time your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line. Each error reduces your skills test score.

questions.question: How far away should you stop your vehicle from students at a bus stop?
questions.explanation: A school bus should stop at least 10 feet away from students. This makes students walk toward the bus, so you can watch their movements and know where they are.

questions.question: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, what should you do?

options.text: Go straight forward, then back to the right.
Go straight forward, then back to the left.
Go forward to the right, then back in a straight line.
Go forward to the left, then back in a straight line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go straight forward, then back to the right.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, first go straight forward, then back up to the right. Your vehicle must be completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, be sure that:

options.text: Emergency exits are hard to open.
Emergency exits cannot be reached from inside the cab.

questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection, make sure any emergency exit warning devices work. All emergency exits should open and close smoothly and be undamaged.

questions.question: During the on-road skills test, you will be graded on gear use. Which should you avoid?

options.text: Selecting a gear that does not rev the engine.
Forgetting to shift through an intersection.

questions.explanation: During the on-road skills test, select a gear that does not rev or lug the engine. Avoid grinding gears and do not shift during turns or intersections.
